note: handler_code is nullable; '+' concatenation makes claim_ref NULL when handler_code is NULL; must use concat (not concat_ws).
CONVERT style 103 gives dd/mm/yyyy; Spark needs date_format 'dd/MM/yyyy'.
CONVERT(CHAR(6), d, 112) truncates yyyymmdd to yyyymm; Spark needs date_format 'yyyyMM'.
DATEDIFF(DAY) on DATE equals day difference, but Spark datediff(end,start) reverses argument order; naive translation flips the sign.
